message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && grep -RIn "commissioner get\|c/cg\|CommissioningData" tests/fuzz src/core | head -50 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":45,"var":"data","code":"memcpy(buf, data, frame.mLength);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a radio frame payload that will be injected into the OpenThread stack.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"value"}]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":63,"var":"frame","code":"otPlatRadioReceiveDone(instance, &frame, OT_ERROR_NONE);","note":"The crafted frame is delivered as if it were received from the radio, entering the packet-processing path.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"payload bytes"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/core/coap/coap.cpp","function":"CoapBase::ProcessReceivedRequest","line":589,"var":"aMessage","code":"resource->HandleRequest(aMessage, aMessageInfo);","note":"The received CoAP request is dispatched to the matching resource handler based on its URI path.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"parsed CoAP request"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::HandleCommissioningGet","line":287,"var":"aMessage","code":"SendCommissioningGetResponse(aMessage, aMessageInfo, tlvs, length);","note":"The commissioning GET handler extracts requested TLVs from the attacker-controlled CoAP payload and forwards them for response construction.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"commissioner GET option"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::SendCommissioningGetResponse","line":341,"var":"cur","code":"if (cur->GetType() == aTlvs[index])","note":"The response builder iterates over the stored commissioning dataset and compares each nested TLV type against the requested type list.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"requested TLV type"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::SendCommissioningGetResponse","line":341,"var":"cur","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = message->AppendTlv(*cur));","note":"A matching TLV is appended to the outgoing response by dereferencing the current TLV object; the crash hypothesis is that malformed or truncated commissioning data causes an out-of-bounds read here while walking the TLV chain.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"match on attacker-selected TLV type"}]}]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 127.
